errors.network: We could not reach MediLink. Check your connection and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait {{seconds}} seconds, then try again.
errors.rateLimitedNoTime: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
errors.sessionExpired: You were logged out. Log in again to continue.
errors.loadFailed: We could not load your account.

validation.emailInvalid: Enter an email address in the correct format, like name@example.rw
validation.termsRequired: Accept the terms of use to create an account
validation.privacyRequired: Accept the privacy notice to create an account

landing.title: Find care in Rwanda
landing.heroBody: Find a health facility that accepts your insurance, book, and arrive when it is your turn.

how.title: How it works
how.step1Body: Search by service, place and insurance. See which facilities accept your insurance.
how.step2Body: Choose a time, or join today’s queue from your phone.
how.step3Body: Follow your place in the queue. We tell you when to leave home.

trust.title: Your data stays in Rwanda
trust.body: Your information is encrypted, stored in Rwanda, and shared only with the facilities that care for you.

rwanda.title: Stored in Rwanda
rwanda.body: Your information never leaves the country.

encrypted.title: Encrypted
encrypted.body: Only the staff caring for you can open your record, and you see who did.

verified.title: Verified facilities only
verified.body: Every facility is checked against its Ministry of Health licence.

facilities.title: For health facilities
facilities.body: Run your queue, records and billing in one place, and let patients find you.

tracker.title: Wait at home, not in the corridor
tracker.body: After you book or join the queue, your phone shows your place and when to leave. It keeps working on a weak network.

points.ahead: How many people are ahead of you, updated live
points.leave: When to leave home, from your travel time
points.called: A clear alert with sound when it is your turn

tracker.caption: Example of the queue tracker on a phone: ticket G-023, 4 people ahead, about 25 to 35 minutes.

records.title: Your records in one place
records.body: Everything from your visits stays with you, for you and the family members you care for.

prescriptions.title: Prescriptions
prescriptions.body: Show them at any pharmacy, even on paper.

receipts.title: Receipts
receipts.body: What you paid and what insurance covered.

notes.title: Sick notes and results
notes.body: Ready to share with your employer or school.

qr.title: Checkable by QR
qr.body: Anyone can check a document is real, without seeing your health data.

insurance.q: Does it work with Mutuelle de Santé?
insurance.a: Yes. Search by your insurance to see which facilities accept it and what you will pay.

cost.q: Does MediLink cost anything for patients?
cost.a: No. Booking, the queue tracker and your records are free for patients.

privacy.q: Who can see my health information?
privacy.a: Only the staff caring for you. You can see every time your record was opened.

smartphone.q: I don’t have a smartphone. Can I still use it?
smartphone.a: Yes. Ask at reception: they can register you and give you a ticket, and you keep your MediLink number.

emergency.title: Emergency?
emergency.body: Go to the nearest emergency department or call 912. MediLink is not for emergencies.

login.title: Log in or create an account
login.intro: Book care and skip the long wait.
login.createAccount: Create an account with this email
login.invalidCredentials: The email or password is not right. Check them and try again.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.intro: It takes about a minute. You can add insurance and family members later.
signup.passwordHint: Use at least 15 characters. A short sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.
signup.languageHint: We send reminders and messages in this language.
signup.consentIntro: Before we create your account, please read this:
signup.consentPoint1: Your health information is encrypted and stored in Rwanda.
signup.consentPoint2: Only the facilities that care for you can see your records.
signup.consentPoint3: You can download your data or delete your account at any time.
signup.terms: I accept the terms of use
signup.privacy: I have read the privacy notice and agree to how MediLink uses my information
signup.research: I agree that my anonymised data may be used for health research
signup.researchHint: Optional. Saying no changes nothing about your care. You can change this later.

home.title: Home
home.nextVisitEmpty: No visits yet. When you book or join a queue, it will show here.
home.verifyEmailBody: We sent a link to {{email}}. Confirm your email before you can see your health records.
home.findCareBody: Join today's queue at a MediLink facility and follow your turn from here, so you wait less in the waiting room.

links.privacy: Privacy and who saw my records

verify.title: Verify a document
verify.body: Soon pharmacies and employers can check a prescription, receipt or sick note here with its code or QR.

forFacilities.title: MediLink for health facilities
forFacilities.body: Facility registration opens in the next release. You will be able to apply online and go live after verification.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.body: The full terms of use will be published here before launch, in Kinyarwanda, English and French.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.body: The full privacy notice will be published here before launch, in Kinyarwanda, English and French.

help.title: Help
help.body: Guides for patients and caregivers are coming. No smartphone? Ask at reception.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: Check the address, or go back to the home page.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter your email. If it belongs to an account, we will send a link to set a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for {{email}}, a reset link is on its way. The link works for 30 minutes.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.hint: At least 15 characters. A short sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.
reset.doneBody: Your password was changed and you were logged out everywhere. Log in with your new password.
reset.invalidLink: This link is incomplete. Open the link from the email again, or ask for a new one.

shell.offline: You're offline. You're seeing what was last saved on this phone.

findCare.title: Find care
findCare.intro: How you can see a doctor with MediLink today.

walkIn.title: Visit today
walkIn.body: Go to a MediLink facility during opening hours. You don't need an appointment.

steps.reception: Tell reception your name or MediLink number.
steps.ticket: You get a ticket number, for example G-023.
steps.track: Follow your turn on My visits. We tell you when you're next.

walkIn.note: Your ticket also shows on the screen in the waiting room.

book.title: Book a time
book.body: Choose a facility, a day and a time, and see your share of the cost before you book.

symptoms.title: Not sure what you need?
symptoms.body: Soon you can describe your symptoms and we'll suggest the right service. This will never replace a doctor.

support.title: Help

ticket.q: How do I follow my turn?
ticket.a: After reception checks you in, open My visits. Your ticket number, how many people are ahead and the expected wait are there. We tell you when you're next.

family.q: Can I manage my child's visits?
family.a: Yes. Add your child under Family. You can then switch to their profile from the top of the screen.

language.q: How do I change the language or make the text bigger?
language.a: Open Settings from the account menu. You can choose Kinyarwanda, English or French and a larger text size.

data.q: Who can see my health records?
data.a: Only staff at a facility where you are being cared for. Every time someone opens your record it is logged, and you can see the list under Privacy.

support.deskBody: No smartphone, or stuck? Reception staff at any MediLink facility can check you in and answer questions.
support.reportBody: Soon you can report a problem with a visit, a payment or a document here and follow what happens.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: These choices apply right away and are kept on this device.
settings.textSizeHint: Larger text makes every screen easier to read. Buttons grow with it.
settings.travelBody: When you have a ticket, tell us how long it takes you to reach the facility. We use it to tell you when to leave home.
settings.alertsBody: Soon you can choose how we reach you: on this phone, by SMS or by email.
